protocol: Use only the four captured width-four batches, with all original jobs, rows and packed weights. Keep five pinned workers in every arm. Compare stock with caller participation, stock with a reserved caller, by-expert with a reserved caller, and by-expert early publication with a reserved caller. Time both format cells separately, with five samples in each of three independent counterbalanced blocks. The early callback records the actual first-pair readiness clock. Record the remaining host time through pool retirement without GPU work. Keep exact output, guard, affinity, work, sample floor and timer-overhead checks. A format is eligible for an overlap trial only if its early whole-pass time less its measured post-publication tail beats the six-core stock time in all three blocks. This ideal headroom is a CPU-only necessary condition and includes no GPU split or submission cost.
